failure_or_stopping_observations: No traceback is reported in evidence/index.json execution records; execution logs show saved renders.
The original checkpoint was not run through the new check before repair; the original contact defect came from received guidance.

The student sampled only lowest wheel vertices against the floor and printed shell/post Z ranges; these do not establish full surface nonpenetration or structural connectivity. The final per-wheel check was not rerun after later scene rebuilds, although the chair code remained unchanged.
The selected candidate is the default in final_source/build.py:57; the alternate whole-chair code remains available but is not the delivered scene.
No separate reusable general-purpose snippet was delivered; check_chairs.py is scene-specific.

candidate_knowledge.problem: Chair casters visibly or geometrically separated from support
candidate_knowledge.observed_defect: Teacher-provided diagnosis identifies both chair bases above floor; original student-side measurement is unknown.
candidate_knowledge.cause_hypothesis: Original cylinder axis and fixed elevation or a misplaced complete assembly could account for separation; the cause is not proven.
candidate_knowledge.executed_method: Compared fixed whole-assembly lowering with upright caster reorientation and fork bars; checked evaluated low vertices using downward floor BVH rays and inspected side renders.
candidate_knowledge.evidence: received_guidance.txt:1-3; baseline_build.py:72-75; final_source/build.py:55-85; check_chairs.py:7-28; sdk_events.json events 12–29, 46
candidate_knowledge.applicability: This specific two-chair, plank-floor scene; cross-scene transfer untested.
candidate_knowledge.verification: Both candidate logs show zero rounded gaps at sampled minima for all ten wheels. Independent final evaluator target_geometry.json reports sampled gaps near 1e-7, within its 1e-4 tolerance.
candidate_knowledge.side_effects: Lowering shifts seat height; reoriented casters change wheel silhouette and add connectors.
candidate_knowledge.unvalidated: Complete floor intersection, wheel-to-spoke and post-to-seat surface connectivity and clearance are not established by sampled rays or Z ranges; no dynamics or hidden reference geometry.

limitations: Student-visible side views and measurements were generated after candidate creation; evaluator scene states and target_geometry are independent posthoc evidence, not student actions.
Rounded zero gaps are sampled vertical differences, not a proof of absence of any penetration; no student surface-distance test was run.
The whole variant remains in delivered source as an optional branch but is not retained in the saved final scene.
No evidence of a full-reference image plane replacing the modeled scene; hidden geometry and cross-scene transfer are unavailable.
